card.title: TPS53219A single buck controller pinout and function reference

source.title: TPS53219A Pinout and Pin Functions Table

claims.statement: The TPS53219A generates +5V STBY from a +12V power supply.
claims.evidence: Text in top right corner: 'This power regulator will generate +5v STBY. It is created from the +12V power supply.'

claims.statement: EN, SW, and VDD are the most important pins to measure for troubleshooting.
claims.evidence: Blue arrows pointing to EN, SW, and VDD pins in the table with a green highlight box labeled 'Most important pins to measure'.

card.caveats: This image provides a pinout and functional description but does not provide specific voltage or resistance measurement values for troubleshooting.
